newsitem.title: INDIA: India monetary policy meeting Oct 19, CRR cut seen.
newsitem.headline: India monetary policy meeting Oct 19, CRR cut seen.

text.p: Executives of India's leading banks will meet the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) governor Chakravarty Rangarajan next Saturday to discuss monetary policy for the second half of financial 1996/97 (April-March), bankers said.

"We have received a communication from the RBI asking us to meet the (RBI) governor on October 19," said a chairman of a state-run bank on Saturday. "The RBI will outline its monetary policy and discuss the implications with us."
Bankers said they expected the RBI to announce a cut in banks' cash reserve requirements.
"This will augment banks' lendable resources," said one banker. "This will also be a signal to the market to bring interest rates down."
The bank chairman said one of the prime concerns before the central bank would be to lower interest rates.
"Inflation is currently around 6.5 percent," he said. "This means that a prime lending rate of 15.5 percent translates into a real interest rate of around nine percent. This is too high."
